reason: I already pay about 20 a month for an AI assistant with a saved project per client, plus my scheduler, and on 27k a year another subscription is hard to justify. The client approval link is nice, but I'd try the free trial and probably not pay.
objection: Another subscription on top of my scheduler, for something my ChatGPT/Claude projects already do for captions. I'm not convinced the voice would be any better than what I already have.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that the approval link saves me real chasing time with clients, and a price low enough (around 10) that it replaces my AI subscription rather than adding to it.
